product_summary: Hemadri Chemicals (Mulund West, Mumbai; proprietorship, GST 27ABRPU3221F1ZH, IEC 0315016710, est. 2010, CEO/proprietor Hemadri Hemant Upadhyay) is a broad-line industrial/agro chemical trader-distributor with ~30 product families and 100+ SKUs on its own site (hemadrichemicals.com) and IndiaMART storefront. Confirmed real product lines: (1) Benzoic acid 99% — flakes, needle crystals, powder, pharma/food/technical grades, spec sheet with assay 99.0-100.5%, m.p. 120-124 C (hemadrichemicals.com/benzoic-acid.html); (2) Zinc sulphate heptahydrate/monohydrate and 'sulphated mixture fertilizer' / micronutrient fertilizers; (3) Magnesium sulphate heptahydrate and monohydrate; (4) Ferrous sulphate powder/BP-USP/anhydrous/crystal; (5) Copper sulphate pentahydrate; (6) Manganese oxide powder (MnO, 99%, 50 kg) and manganese sulphate monohydrate; (7) Zinc oxide 99.9%/76%, paint and electroplating grades; (8) Sodium phosphates — TSP (anhydrous and dodecahydrate), MSP/sodium dihydrogen phosphate, DSP, DKP, MKP, DAP; (9) Sulphamic acid powder/crystals; (10) Boric acid / orthoboric acid IP; (11) Oxalic acid powder/dihydrate; (12) Citric acid mono/anhydrous; (13) Sodium acetate trihydrate/anhydrous; (14) Sodium benzoate food grade; (15) Sodium sulphate anhydrous (Glauber salt); (16) Caustic soda flakes; (17) Hydrochloric acid liquid; (18) Ammonium sulphate; (19) Potassium sulphate; (20) Mono chloro acetic acid / sodium monochloroacetate; (21) Sulphanilic acid purified; (22) Borax decahydrate granular/powder; (23) Potassium ferricyanide; (24) Isopropyl alcohol; (25) Ethylene glycol technical grade; (26) Menthol bold crystals BP/USP, terpeneless menthol; (27) Guar gum powder; (28) Pectin powder food grade; (29) Rubber accelerator DM/MBTS; (30) Anti-dusting oil, boiler descaling chemicals, industrial cleaning soap, filter pads. Declared HS 291814 is a real, corroborated line but covers only benzoic acid — and even that is mis-numbered (see comment).
comment: HS VERDICT: partial — the company is kept in the base, code corrected, no rejection (per rule 3). CRITICAL CODE ERROR: 2918.14 is CITRIC ACID and its salts, not benzoic acid. Benzoic acid, its salts and esters sit in 2916.31 (benzoic acid) / 2916.32 (sodium benzoate). The site sells BOTH benzoic acid (2916.31) and citric acid (2918.14), so the declared code is not simply 'wrong' — it is attached to the wrong product in the declaration. Correct primary code for the declared benzoic-acid line: 291631. If the declaration was meant to cover citric acid, 291814 is right but the product name in the file is wrong. Either way the declared single 6-digit code covers roughly 1 of 30 product families actually traded — the declaration is drastically under-scoped. INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is misleading. This is a general industrial/inorganic-salt and food-additive chemical distributor; there is no oil & gas, no upstream/drilling activity. Only tangential O&G link is benzoic acid's use as a drilling-mud additive and anti-dusting oil, which is a downstream application, not a sector. Correct industry: basic/industrial chemicals wholesale (inorganic salts, phosphates, fertilizer micronutrients, food preservatives). TRADER SIGNS: the firm self-describes inconsistently — IndiaMART factsheet says 'Trader - Wholesaler/Distributor' with 'Additional Business: Retail Business, Office/Sale Office', while the About page claims 'Manufacturer, Trader and Supplier' with a 'manufacturing unit spread over a large area' and in-house QC lab. No plant address, capacity, or machinery is disclosed anywhere; registered address is an office/shop at No. 216, 2nd Floor, Gala Complex, Gala Industrial Estate, Mulund West — a trading-estate office, not a plant. Treat manufacturing claims as unverified marketing; role = trader. PRODUCT LINES MISSING FROM DECLARATION: essentially the entire catalogue except benzoic acid — zinc/ferrous/copper/manganese/magnesium sulphates (2833), zinc oxide (2817), sodium phosphates and DAP/MKP/DKP (2835), sulphamic acid (2811), boric acid (2810), borax (2840), oxalic acid (2917), citric acid (2918.14), sodium acetate (2915.29), sodium benzoate (2916.32), caustic soda (2815.11), HCl (2806.10), IPA (2905.12), ethylene glycol (2909.43), menthol (2906.11), guar gum (1302.32), pectin (1302.20), rubber accelerators (3812.10), micronutrient fertilizers (3105.90). HS codes above are my mapping from the published catalogue; the list is deliberately exhaustive and includes several near-duplicate/alternative codes where the exact grade (hydrate vs anhydrous, technical vs food) changes the 6-digit heading — the operative ones are 2916.31, 2833.29, 2817.00, 2835.29, 2811.19, 2810.00, 2918.14, 2915.29, 2916.32. EVIDENCE STATUS: every product above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — sourced only from the company's own website and IndiaMART storefront (hemadrichemicals.com, /aboutus.html, /benzoic-acid.html, /industrial-chemical.html). No customs line, B-L, or GST turnover record was checked in this task (out of scope per role), so no shipment is corroborated here. Export destinations Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, USA, Ethiopia are self-declared on the About page only — 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Note the site's own About page mislabels the proprietor as 'Ms. Hemadri (CEO)' and uses 'He' in the same sentence, while the GST partner name is Hemadri Hemant Upadhyay — a data-quality flag, not a rejection ground. No PAN, CIN or revenue verified in this task (null).
